description: Luuka's rules for the three advances, as settings: the minutes of 16 and 20 July 2026 (Reward and Compensation, §4.4 and §4.9) and LPL/HR/21. Every advance is checked against these when it is raised, and a salary advance again on the day it is processed.

fields.label: Salary Advance
fields.description: Minutes §4.9: 40% of gross, or a standard rate for the Per Meter category; processed on the 15th, or the working day before when that is a weekend or public holiday.

fields.label: Per Meter Standard Rate
fields.description: What a Per Meter employee is advanced, whatever their gross. Nought means the percentage applies to them too.

fields.label: Weekend or Public Holiday: the Working Day Before
fields.description: Public holidays are read from the company's default Holiday List; Saturday and Sunday are always skipped because the bank does not process on them.

fields.label: Requests Close (Days Before)
fields.description: A request made after this joins the next month's run instead. The minutes say only "in time" — confirm the day with Luuka.

fields.label: Finance Waits for the Processing Date
fields.description: The Payroll Officer cannot pass a salary advance to Finance before the day it is processed, because the absences are only final on that day.

fields.label: Recovered In (Months)
fields.description: From the same month's payroll, which closes on the 25th.

fields.label: Regular Employees Only
fields.description: Who is not regular is set at the bottom of this page.

fields.label: Not on Leave
fields.description: On an approved leave on the processing date.

fields.label: Most Days Absent
fields.description: Counted from the start of the payroll period (the 26th) to the processing date. Nought means no absence at all.

fields.label: Approved Off-Duty Days Are Not Absences
fields.description: A day marked absent that an approved Off Duty Request (LPL/HR/25) covers is not counted.

fields.label: No Bank Loan
fields.description: Read from Has a Bank Loan on the employee.

fields.label: Nothing Owed on an Earlier Advance
Least Months Served
fields.description: The minutes set no such rule; nought leaves it off.

fields.label: Leave Advance
fields.description: Minutes §4.4: 60% of gross — for the Per Meter category, of the average gross over the previous months — for regular employees with no bank or company loan, taking more than 19 days of leave.

fields.label: Per Meter: Average Gross Over (Months)
fields.description: Their pay is output-based, so one month's gross is not a fair base.

fields.label: Who Is Regular
fields.description: Anyone whose Employment Type is listed here is not a regular employee for the salary and leave advances. Casuals were put here when this page was made; add Probation, Intern or anything else Luuka does not advance.

fields.label: Employment Types That Are Not Regular

name: Advance Settings
